4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: A sudden push to act before you have thought it through.
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: A sudden push to act before you have thought it through.

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: 充分に考え込む前に sudden に行動したくなる commissionの勢いのこと。理性的な判断とは別で、それ自体には善悪の判断が含まれない。
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: よく考え込む前に sudden に较强的冲动。

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: 사유가 끝나기 전에 즉각 행동하고 싶은 마음이다. 외부 자극이나 감정에서 갑자기 생기는 충동이며, 숙고한 결심과는 구별된다.
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: 충분히 생각하기 전에 행동을 재촉하는 갑작스러운 충동.

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: Desejo ou impulso espontâneo que provoca uma ação imediata, antes de uma reflexão adequada. Pode também designar um movimento breve e involuntário.
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: Um impulso súbito que leva a agir antes de pensar bem.

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: Dorongan tiba-tiba untuk melakukan sesuatu sebelum.Layout tersebut dipikirkan secara saksama. Istilah ini merujuk pada dorongan yang arises secara spontan, bukanATIONALITY keputusan yang telah dipertimbangkan.
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: Dorongan mendadak untuk bertindak sebelum dipikirkan secara saksama.

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: ความอยากหรือแรงกระตุ้นที่เกิดขึ้นอย่างฉับพลันให้ปฏิบัติต่อโดยยังไม่ได้พิจารณาผลของการกระทำ
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: แรงกระตุ้นฉับพลันให้ลงมือก่อนคิดให้รอบคอบ

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.definition: Düşünme sürecini tamamlamadan aniden bir eyleme girişe yol açan güçlü istek; ani tepki anlamına gelir.
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.gloss: Düşünmeden harekete geçmeyi sağlayan ani dürtü.

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.translation: Hemen yanıtlama dürtüsü, vereceği yanıttan daha güçlüydü.
แรงกระตุ้นที่จะตอบทันทีนั้นแรงกว่าคำตอบที่คิดไว้
Dorongan untuk langsung menjawab lebih kuat daripada jawaban yang sebenarnya.
O impulso de responder imediatamente era mais forte do que a resposta.
곧바로 답장하려는 충동이 곁들린 답보다 더 강했다.
すぐ返事したい impulse の方が、答えより強かった。

4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.text: The impulse to reply at once was stronger than the answer.
4623dc82702b4964a50b342ab08621202e59a18a.translation: Bản năng muốn trả lời ngay lập tức mạnh hơn câu trả lời.

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: Slowing the car with the engine and the gearbox instead of with the brake pedal.
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: Slowing the car with the engine and the gearbox instead of with the brake pedal.

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: ブレーキペダルを使わずに、エンジンの抵抗と変速機を利用して車両を減速させる方法。長い下り坂でブレーキの过热を防ぐために用いる。
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: ブレーキペダルではなく、エンジンと変速機を使って減速すること。

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: 제동 페달을 밟지 않고 엔진과 변속기의 저항을 이용해 차량을 감속하는 방법. 장거리 하강에서 브레이크 과열을 줄이는 데 유용하다.
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: 제동 페달 대신 엔진과 변속기로 차량의 속도를 줄이는 방법.

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: Uso do motor e do câmbio para desacelerar o veículo em vez de acionar o freio. É especialmente útil em descidas, pois evita o superaquecimento dos freios.
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: Redução da velocidade do carro pelo motor e pelo câmbio, sem usar o pedal de freio.

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: Cara memperlambat kendaraan menggunakan mesin dan transmisi, bukan pedal rem. Cara ini membantu menjaga rem tetap dingin pada turunan panjang.
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: Memperlambat kendaraan dengan mesin dan transmisi, bukan dengan pedal rem.

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: วิธีชะลอความเร็วของรถโดยใช้แรงต้านจากเครื่องยนต์ผ่านชุดเกียร์ แทนการกดเบรก ช่วยให้เบรกไม่ร้อนเกินไปและมีแรงเบรกต่อเนื่อง
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: การใช้แรงเครื่องยนต์และเกียร์ช่วยชะลอรถแทนการเหยียบเบรก

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.definition: Aracın hızını fren pedalı kullanmadan motor ve şanzıman aracılığıyla düşürmesidir. Özellikle uzun yokuşlarda frenlerin aşırı ısınmasını önlemek için kullanılır.
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.gloss: Aracı fren pedalı yerine motor ve şanzımanla yavaşlatmak.

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.translation: Uzun yokuşta motorla yavaşlattı ve frenler soğuk kaldı.
ระหว่างลงทางลาดยาว เขาใช้การเบรกด้วยเครื่องยนต์ ทำให้เบรกยังคงเย็นอยู่
Saat turun panjang, ia menggunakan pengereman mesin sehingga rem tetap dingin.
Na longa descida, ele usou a frenagem do motor e os freios permaneceram frios.
긴 내리막길에서는 엔진 제동을 사용하여 브레이크를 식혔다.
長い下り坂ではエンジンブレーキを使い、ブレーキを冷えた状態に保った。

463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.text: On the long descent he used engine braking and the brakes stayed cool.
463d5fecb19680adc51327f4b3bedb4f1a62a161.translation: Trên một đoạn đường đi xuống dốc dài, anh ấy dùng phanh bằng động cơ và phanh vẫn mát.

464f25cc8f0583f3c452ea2f988f7b9f9189c9f0.definition: Mức đường thẳng nghiêng; trong y = mx + b, m là slope.
How steep the line is; the coefficient of x.
464f25cc8f0583f3c452ea2f988f7b9f9189c9f0.gloss: How steep the line is; the coefficient of x.

464f25cc8f0583f3c452ea2f988f7b9f9189c9f0.text: A horizontal line has slope zero.
464f25cc8f0583f3c452ea2f988f7b9f9189c9f0.translation: Đường nằm ngang có độ dốc bằng không.

46599c5bb5c33101f80cea8438e2228085513dbb.definition: Động từ be ở dạng nguyên mẫu.
The verb that links a subject to a complement.
46599c5bb5c33101f80cea8438e2228085513dbb.gloss: The verb be in its infinitive form.

4666a3f66bc600ad9f11fa871e13e32f1c0fe8ba.definition: Đường kín để dòng điện chạy qua các phần tử.
A closed path that electric current flows around.
4666a3f66bc600ad9f11fa871e13e32f1c0fe8ba.gloss: A closed path that electric current flows around.

4666a3f66bc600ad9f11fa871e13e32f1c0fe8ba.text: Close the circuit before you measure current.
4666a3f66bc600ad9f11fa871e13e32f1c0fe8ba.translation: Khép mạch trước khi đo dòng.

4666a3f66bc600ad9f11fa871e13e32f1c0fe8ba.text: A short circuit bypasses the load.

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: The money of a country: its notes, its coins, and the rules that govern them.
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: The money of a country: its notes, its coins, and the rules that govern them.

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: ある国のお金の単位のこと。発行される紙幣・硬貨や額面、交換のきまりなどを含む。
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: その国の紙幣・硬貨と、それらに関する取り決め。

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: 한 나라의 지폐와 동전으로 이루어진 돈과 이를 다루는 규칙을 이룬다. 통화는 서로 다른 나라의 돈과 구별된다.
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: 한 나라에서 통용하는 돈과 그 사용 규칙.

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: Dinheiro utilizado em um país, composto por cédulas, moedas e pelos regulamentos que governam sua emissão e circulação.
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: Moeda oficial de um país, incluindo cédulas, moedas e regras de emissão.

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: Mata uang adalah uang yang berlaku di suatu negara, termasuk uang kertas, uang logam, dan aturan yang mengaturnya.
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: Mata uang adalah uang yang berlaku di suatu negara, termasuk uang kertas, uang logam, dan aturan yang mengaturnya.

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: เงินที่ใช้ในประเทศหนึ่ง ได้แก่ ธนบัตร เหรียญ และกฎเกณฑ์เกี่ยวกับการออกและใช้เงินตรา
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: ระบบเงินของประเทศ ทั้งธนบัตร เหรียญ และกฎเกณฑ์ที่กำกับ

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.definition: Bir ülkenin banknotlarından, madeni paralarından ve bunların kullanımını düzenleyen kurallardan oluşan para birimi.
466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.gloss: Bir ülkenin banknot, madeni para ve para sistemi.

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.translation: Dükkân yalnızca yerel para birimini kabul eder.
ร้านค้านี้รับเฉพาะสกุลเงินท้องถิ่น
Toko itu hanya menerima mata uang setempat.
A loja aceita apenas a moeda local.
이 가게에서는 지역 통화만 받을 수 있습니다.
この店はその国の通貨だけを受け付ける。

466e5b9cd57fa444cceaa8e5b053ddd58d05cbbc.text: The shop takes only the local currency.

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: The name of the pattern of three moves: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: The name of the pattern of three moves: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: 「否認・攻撃・被害者と加害者の立場の反転」という三つの手順をまとめた呼称である。否定、攻撃、反転の順に現れることが多い。
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: 否認、攻撃、加害者と被害者の立場の入れ替えの三つを指す呼び方。

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: 문제를 부인하고, 문제를 제기한 사람을 공격한 뒤, 피해자와 가해자의 역할을 뒤집는 세 단계 대응 방식이다. 이 세 단계는 서로의 행동과 의도를 왜곡해 원래의 문제를 흐리는 데 초점을 둔다.
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: 부인, 공격, 피해자와 가해자의 역할 뒤집기로 이루어진 세 단계 대응.

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: Nome de um padrão de três movimentos: negar, atacar e inverter as posições de vítima e agressor. O termo é uma designação para essa sequência, não um diagnóstico.
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: Padrão que combina negação, ataque e a inversão entre vítima e agressor.

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: Istilah untuk pola yang menggabungkan penyangkalan terhadaprees alleged, serangan terhadap orang yang menuduh, dan pembalikan peran korban serta pelaku. Tujuannya adalah menggugurkan tanggung jawab atas tindakan yang dilakukan.
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: Pola tiga langkah: menyangkal, menyerang, lalu membalik peran korban dan pelaku.

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: รูปแบบการรับมือสามขั้นตอน ได้แก่ ปฏิเสธ โจมตี และกลับบทให้เหยื่อกับผู้กระทำ โดย DARVO เป็นชือย่อของแนวคิดนี้
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: รูปแบบ DARVO ซึ่งเปลี่ยนผู้กระทำเป็นผู้ถูกกระทำ

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.definition: Bir olayı reddetme, karşıdakine saldırma ve ardından mağdur ile suçlu rollerini yer değiştirerek sorumluluğu aktarma örüntüsü. Kısaltması, bu üç adımı belirtir.
467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.gloss: Reddetme, saldırma ve mağdur ile suçlu rollerini tersine çevirme biçimindeki üç adımlı örüntü.

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.translation: Örüntü DARVO'ydu: reddetme, saldırma ve mağdur ile suçlu rollerini tersine çevirme.
รูปแบบนี้คือ DARVO เพราะเขาปฏิเสธข้อกล่าวหา โจมตีผู้อื่น แล้วกลับบทให้ตนเป็นผู้ถูกกระทำ
Pola itu disebut DARVO: menyangkal, menyerang, lalu membalik peran korban dan pelaku.
O padrão era DARVO: negar, atacar e inverter as posições de vítima e agressor.
그 패턴은 DARVO였다. 부인하고, 공격하고, 피해자와 가해자의 역할을 뒤집었다.
そのパターンはDARVOだった。否認、攻撃、そして被害者と加害者の反転だ。

467759581c80bdcdf1bbc37b72cdc08070a63e99.text: The pattern was DARVO: deny, attack, and reverse victim and offender.

46acbe5cf42ee3269d1c3c43a6b570edf298f5aa.definition: The habit of adding a small sum on top of a bill for the person who served you.
46acbe5cf42ee3269d1c3c43a6b570edf298f5aa.gloss: The habit of adding a small sum on top of a bill for the person who served you.

46acbe5cf42ee3269d1c3c43a6b570edf298f5aa.text: In this restaurant the service charge is on the bill, so there is no tip to add.

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: The quality of a test that asks whether it measures what it claims to measure.
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: The quality of a test that asks whether it measures what it claims to measure.

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: テストや測定が('@' measures ['@']) actually測]pyres[/pyres]提到的ものを、意図どおりに測っているか。信頼性とは別の概念。
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: テストが意図したものを正しく測れているという性質。

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: 검사나 평가가 무엇을 측정한다고 주장하는지, 그리고 실제로 그 대상을 제대로 측정하는지를 나타내는 성질. 일관된 결과가 나왔더라도 타당할 필요는 없다.
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: 검사가 주장하는 대상을 실제로 측정하는 정도.

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: Adequação da interpretação de um teste ao que ele se propõe a medir. Um teste pode ser confiável e, ainda assim, não ser válido para determinada finalidade.
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: Qualidade de um teste que realmente mede aquilo que afirma medir.

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: Mutu suatu tes yang mengukur apa yang diklaimnya ukur. Sebuah tes bisa andal tetapi tidak valid, sebab andalnya mengukur sesuatu yang lain.
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: Mutu suatu tes yang mengukur apa yang diklaimnya ukur.

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: คุณสมบัติของแบบทดสอบที่วัดได้ตรงกับสิ่งที่แบบทดสอบนั้นอ้างว่าจะวัด แบบทดสอบอาจมีความเชื่อถือได้แต่ไม่แม่นยำในสิ่งที่ใช้วัด
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: คุณสมบัติของแบบทดสอบที่วัดสิ่งที่อ้างว่าจะวัดจริง

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.definition: Bir testin gerçekten ölçmeyi amaçladığı özelliği ölçme derecesi. Güvenilir olmayan bir test geçerli de olabilir; bu nedenle güvenilirlik ve geçerlilik ayrı değerlendirilir.
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.gloss: Bir testin iddia ettiği şeyi ölçme niteliği.

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.translation: Test güvenilirdi ama yaptığımız iş için geçerli değildi.
แบบทดสอบนั้นมีความเชื่อถือได้ แต่ไม่แม่นยำสำหรับงานที่เราทำ
Tes itu andal tetapi tidak valid untuk pekerjaan yang kami kerjakan.
O teste era confiável, mas não válido para o trabalho que realizamos.
그 검사는 신뢰할 수 있었지만, 우리가 하는 업무에는 타당하지 않았다.
このテストは信頼性があったが、私たちの仕事には妥当性がなかった。

46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.text: The test was reliable but not valid for the work we do.
46acef2c121293e78ec5c623f90d1247d94361c5.translation: Bài kiểm tra đó tin cậy nhưng không có giá trị cho công việc chúng tôi đang làm.

46b8694afc7d033ce6851aa4ed944628de704bba.definition: A planned event moved to a later date.
46b8694afc7d033ce6851aa4ed944628de704bba.gloss: A planned event moved to a later date.

46b8694afc7d033ce6851aa4ed944628de704bba.definition: 予定されていた行事や契約を後の日付に変更すること。延期と中止は異なる点で、延期では新しい日付が決まっている。
